subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After the branch is rebased to use `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should live Matrix/Element send-read proof be required before merge, or is the in-memory Matrix adapter proof acceptable?
rationale: External PR proof policy asks for real behavior proof, but the code-path proof is targeted and the contributor says they lack homeserver credentials.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element transcript, logs, terminal output, or short recording that shows `/reasoning on` producing an `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` hiding reasoning.

options.title: Waive live transport proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the in-memory Matrix adapter proof after the branch is rebased and the duplicate gate is removed.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element transcript, logs, terminal output, or short recording that shows `/reasoning on` producing an `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` hiding reasoning.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest Matrix-area routing owner in the inspected history and has recent live Matrix QA context from PR 90415.
